قَسَمَ * and ↓ قَسَّمَ He divided; parted; divided in parts or shares; distributed. ― -b2- قَسَمَ أَمْرَهُ, or ↓ قَسَّمَهُ: see 3 in art. عدل.
قَسَّمَ see 1.
قَاسَمَهُ الشَّىْءَ * He divided with him the thing, each of them allotting to himself his share, or portion. ― -b2- قَاسَمَهُ بِاللّٰهِ He swore to him by God.
أَقْسَمَ عَلَيهِ * He conjured him; he said بِحَقِّكَ. (Mgh, art. طمر.)
تَقَسَّمَ * It (a thing) was, or became, divided, or distributed. (MA.) See an ex. in a verse, voce شَتَّانَ.
اِنْقَسَمَ الَى أَقْسَامٍ كَثِيرَةٍ * It was divided into many parts.
اِسْتَقْسَمَ * He sought to know what was allotted to him, by means of the أَزْلَام, (S, * Mgh, and Har, p. 465,) and what was not allotted to him. (Mgh, Har.)
قِسْمٌ * A division: (Msb:) and particularly (Msb) a portion, or share. (S, Msb, K.) Pl. أَقْسَامٌ. ― -b2- لَيسَ مِنْ أَقْساَمِ كَذَا It is not a part of such a thing; it does not belong, or appertain, to such a thing; it is independent of such a thing.
قَسَمٌ * A conjurement. See أَقْسَمَ عَلَيهِ. ― -b2- An oath (S, Msb, K) by God [&c.]. (Msb, K.) An asseveration. ― -b3- وَاوُ القَسَمِ The و denoting an oath.
قِسْمَةٌ * is also used in the sense of مَقْسُومٌ [meaning A thing, or collection of things, divided into portions, or shares]: (Bd and Jel in liv. 28:) a portion, or share; like قِسْمٌ: (Msb:) [and portions, or shares; as in the phrase,] نُخْرِجُ طَرِيقًا مِنْ بَينِ قِسْمَةِ الأَرْضِ أَوِ الدَّارِ [We will exclude a way, or passage, from among the portions, or shares, of the land, or the house]. (Mgh in art. رفع.)
قَسَّامٌ * An officer of the Kádee, who divides inheritances.
